business_problem: replace fragmented Hadoop and BigQuery analytics so teams could unify player data, move faster on game features, and improve player satisfaction with lower cost.
solution_summary: Wargaming uses Snowflake on Snowflake to replace fragmented hadoop and bigquery analytics so teams could unify player data, move faster on game features, and improve player satisfaction with lower cost. Gameplay, monetization, and player-behavior data that once lived across Hadoop and BigQuery are centralized in Snowflake for unified analysis. The platform streamlines high-volume analytics so Wargaming can prepare and query player data faster without forcing teams to search across multiple systems. Design, analytics, and product teams use the faster shared data to personalize experiences, refine monetization, and release features that keep players engaged. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, improves concurrency, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across teams and applications. Wargaming saved about $500,000 a year, achieved 25% average cost savings, and improved data delivery by up to 40% for faster gaming...
